name: Martin

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story residence with a gray multi-gable roof|It is situated with three other properties on a small cul-de-sac|A paved driveway leads to the front of the house and garage area|Multiple vehicles are parked in the driveway|A detached structure is located on one side of the lot|Open lawn, trees, and fencing surround the property|Outdoor features including a trampoline and play equipment are visible in the rear yard.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows a single-story blue home with a gray roof and attached garage|A paved driveway holds multiple vehicles|Landscaped plantings and a front lawn are present|A sidewalk runs along the street frontage.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side elevation of the blue home and a detached structure|A small patio area with table and chairs are visible|A wooden fence runs along portions of the property line|Open ground, trees, and outdoor items are present on this side.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back elevation of the home with a fenced yard|Open lawn, mature trees, a trampoline, and play equipment are visible|Detached structures and outdoor storage are present|Fencing encloses much of the rear area.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side of the blue home with a gray roof|Landscaped plantings and open lawn are present|Portions of the driveway and fencing are visible|Trees and outdoor features continue around this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to the front of the residence and garage, with space for multiple vehicles. The front of the property is open and clearly accessible. A wooden fence encloses much of the rear yard. Open driveway and front yard areas provide space for emergency vehicle staging. The rear yard contains outdoor play equipment and open lawn. Neighboring homes are close in this residential setting.
